# Ali Demirbaş

> Growth marketer for mobile products. Mobile App Growth Lead at Aksigorta in Istanbul, building acquisition, CRM and lifecycle programs on data, not guesswork. Previously Vodafone, Getir and Wingie Enuygun Group. Published in English (default) and Turkish (/tr). The whole site is marked noindex.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/): What the work is, the career in brief, and the Lab projects.
- [About](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/about): Career timeline (Aksigorta, Vodafone, Getir, Wingie Enuygun Group, Albayrak Grubu, Doğuş Oto).
- [Lab](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab): Open-source tools and libraries for lifecycle marketing and marketing analytics.
- [Blog](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/blog): Short pieces on LTV:CAC, retention curves, ROAS attribution, lifecycle journeys versus campaigns, and guardrail metrics. English only.
- [Calculators](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/calculators): Free marketing calculators for ROAS, CAC, CPC, CPM, retention, conversion rates, A/B testing and unit economics. No signup.
- [Stack](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/stack): The tools used day to day, grouped by category.
- [Contact](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/contact): Email and LinkedIn.

## Lab projects

- [Lifecycle Marketing Journey Builder](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/claude-lifecycle): An open-source Claude Code plugin that turns the customer signals you already track into lifecycle journeys you can trigger, measure and improve. Repository: https://github.com/ali-demirbas/claude-lifecycle
- [Canonical Journey Library](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/journeys): Domain-neutral lifecycle journeys written as state machines: triggers, branches, waits, handoffs and exits, not campaign templates. Three public surfaces: customer journeys (/lab/customer-journeys), lifecycle states (/lab/lifecycle-states) and runtime mechanisms (/lab/runtime-mechanisms). Each journey has its own page under /lab/journeys/.
- [A/B Test Playbook](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/ab-testing): Real-world A/B test scenarios with the hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails and statistical checks needed to run them properly. Each scenario has its own page under /lab/ab-testing/.
- [Marketing Dashboard Builder](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/dashboard-builder): Turns marketing exports into validated, comparable metrics and the dashboards built on them.
- [Google Ads Change History Explorer](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/google-ads-change-history-dashboard): Turns a Google Ads change-history export into a searchable single-file dashboard.
- [Numerspace](https://alidemirbas.com.tr/lab/numerspace): Free calculators for marketing, finance, health, career and everyday decisions. No account, no paywall.
